title: A fresh install opens Octave Web in a browser, with nothing copied in
description: Serves PRODUCT.md: "Each release of jellyscale ships a specific, tested release of Octave Web" and "A fresh install opens in a browser." Octave asked for every server to serve Octave Web, with its TV approval page, by the time its Android TV app first ships (#318).
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh install serves Octave Web at the server's address, with nothing for the operator to copy in or configure.
Each jellyscale release names the Octave Web release it ships, and that pair was tested together: signing in, approving a TV, browsing Films and Shows and playing a film in Chromium.
An upgrade of jellyscale that changes the Octave Web it ships never leaves a viewer's open page unable to sign in again.
notes: Needs an Octave Web release that works with the new contract; ask Octave for it on its issue board, don't work around it. Must land before Octave's Android TV app first ships (#318).
